property_summary: After any successful call to withdrawGovernanceAsset, the pending decision for that (target, caller) key must be deleted; the buggy version's inverted time guard prevents the legitimate withdrawal (and delete) from ever running when unlockTime < block.timestamp, so the stale pending record remains observable.
change_summary: Replace the unlock-time guard with one that allows withdrawal when the unlock time is equal to or greater than the current timestamp, instead of strictly less than it.
